name: Privatzimmer Lechner Anton
beschreibung:
Overview

The Privatzimmer Lechner Anton is a privately run guesthouse with the character of an inn or pension in Thiersee, a municipality in the district of Kufstein in Tirol. The address is Glemmtal 7, 6335 Thiersee. Guests stay in simple private rooms with traditional furnishings; the house offers a down-to-earth atmosphere with regional cuisine. Thiersee is located in the Thierseetal valley, about five kilometers west of Kufstein and directly on the border with Bavaria. The quiet location makes the accommodation an ideal starting point for hikes and explorations in the Bavarian Pre-Alps. The village itself is a typical Tyrolean village. The municipal area borders directly on Bavaria and is one of the largest in the Kufstein district by area.

History/Background

No reliable information is available about the history of the house itself; entries describe it as an inn or a guesthouse with private rooms. The municipality of Thiersee was first mentioned in documents in 1224 and belonged to Bavaria until 1504, before becoming part of Tirol. The main town of the extensive municipality is Vorderthiersee; other localities include Hinterthiersee, Landl, Mitterland and Schmiedtal. The region is known, among other things, for its Passion play tradition. The business is located in the hamlet of Glemmtal in the southern part of the municipality, near Landl.

Getting there

Thiersee is about five kilometers west of the district town of Kufstein, close to the border with Bavaria. It can be reached via the roads of the Thierseetal valley; for navigation, the address Glemmtal 7, 6335 Thiersee is the key reference. The hamlet of Glemmtal is located in the southern part of the municipality. Specific information about bus routes, rail connections or parking facilities at the house is not available and should be requested directly from the host; the nearest major transport hub is Kufstein.

Tips

As a quiet accommodation in the village, the house is suitable for guests who want to explore the nature of the Thierseetal valley and the surrounding Pre-Alps. The regional setting and down-to-earth atmosphere will appeal to hikers and those seeking relaxation. As no reliable public information is available regarding facilities, opening hours or prices, it is recommended to contact the host directly before booking. The surrounding area with the Thiersee lake (the namesake) and the nearby district town of Kufstein offers plenty of opportunities for excursions.

The warmer months are ideal for hiking in the Thierseetal valley and the surrounding Pre-Alps; anyone wishing to visit the region outside this time should check the availability of the accommodation in advance.
